text: The benchmark suite is the cargo project benchmarks/ on branch bench only; a worktree of bench is at tmp-claude/2026-11-03-lcp-cap/bench. From its benchmarks/: cargo run --release -- [GROUP] -t 4 -r 5 --bin before=PATH --bin after=PATH -o /home/jack/projects/sufr/benchmarks/runs, at most one group of normal, long-n, long-repeats, protein; default 10 MiB. It fingerprints a first run and refuses two binaries whose output differs, so a change that moves the bytes is timed by hand. Checked 2026-11-03.
